expectations.text: Skill asks for the track (URL/URI/ID) via AskUserQuestion
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Agent asked for clarification (track name or URL).' — agent asked via natural language, not via the structured AskUserQuestion tool with defined options.

expectations.text: After track is provided, skill uses AskUserQuestion with multiSelect:true for playlist selection
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'No mention of multiSelect or structured playlist selection.' — baseline did not present a structured playlist picker.

expectations.text: Skill does NOT run CLI commands until both track and playlist(s) are confirmed
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'No CLI commands run.' — baseline paused to ask for clarification before running any commands.

claims.claim: Baseline recognized missing track from 'dit nummer' and asked for clarification
claims.evidence: Transcript: 'Agent recognized missing track input — user said 'dit nummer' (this track) but provided nothing.'

eval_feedback.overall: Good discrimination on the multiSelect assertion (0 vs 1 from the skill). The baseline's unstructured clarification is less safe — no Random sht exclusion, no playlist enumeration from playlists.json.
